fact: The African Development Bank approved a $1 million grant, run by UNHCR with the Togolese authorities over twelve months, that will support the registration and documentation of 5,000 new arrivals in the Savanes region.
system: registration and documentation of new arrivals

fact: CNAR and UNHCR trained all CNAR technical staff and external data-entry operators on 2-3 August 2025 in Kara to enter socio-economic data for refugees and asylum seekers in CNAR's ProGres V4 registration database.
CNAR states that after four registration operations between 2023 and 2025, 41,773 Burkinabe officially obtained refugee status in Togo.
CNAR states a decentralised operation from 22 May to 16 July 2025 produced and distributed 10,972 refugee identity cards in the Savanes region, produced by the DGDN.
